# DeployVet

> DeployVet runs outside-in website security and bug checks for freelancers, agencies and the clients they build for. It looks at a live site the way a visitor would and reports common, externally visible problems with a score, a grade, severities and fixes. Run by Hayden Young. It is not a penetration test, an audit or a certification.

## What it checks
- Exposed keys and secrets in public JavaScript and files
- Open database tables (public Supabase key with anonymous reads)
- Exposed files and routes (environment files, .git folders, backups, source maps, open admin or API routes)
- Security headers, HTTPS and mixed content
- Broken links and basic search-visibility items
- Findings and scores are rule-based. Fix prompts are templates. Details: https://deployvet.com/methodology.html

## Pricing (USD)
- Free check: $0. One outside check per site each month. Score, grade, summary and the most important finding in full with its fix.
- Scan: $7 one-time. Paid first, then the scan runs. Every finding with evidence and a fix, fix prompts, PDF, read-only check of a public repository or database project.
- Fix it pack: $10 one-time, one site. The Scan plus 30 days of one-click re-checks and score history. No subscription.
- DeployVet Pro: $29/month for teams and agencies, up to 5 sites, weekly checks with email alerts. Start by emailing hello@deployvet.com. Cancel any time.
- Launch Pack: $39 one-time. Launch copy (landing-page rewrite, 5 X posts, 2 LinkedIn posts, a launch email) written with AI and delivered in 48 hours. Marketing copy, not security.
- Paid reports need proof of site ownership (DNS TXT record or meta tag). Only check sites you own or have permission to check.

## Who it is for
- Freelancers and agencies checking client sites before handoff
- Site owners who want a quick outside check

## Who it is not for
- Anyone who needs a formal penetration test, compliance attestation or legal security sign-off
